generalAbilities.name: Shadow Leap
generalAbilities.description:
Requirements The bul-gae is in dim light or darkness

Effect The bul-gae dives into a shadow and reappears from a shadow within 40 feet.

defensiveAbilities.name: Eclipse Aura
defensiveAbilities.description: 100 feet. Light and shadows morph strangely around the bul-gae. A creature attempting to create a light effect within the aura must attempt a DC 5 Flat check. On a failure, the attempt fails, the effect is lost, and the DC to counteract darkness effects within the aura is increased by 1.

defensiveAbilities.name: Solar Flare
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The bul-gae takes damage

Effect The bul-gae releases a solar flare in a 30ft Emanation. Each creature in the area takes 6d8 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 34 Reflex Saving Throw save). On a critical failure, a creature also takes 2d10 Persistent,fire Damage damage. After using this ability, the bul-gae's flames cool and they can't use Solar Flare again until after they have used Lunar Burst.

offensiveAbilities.name: Lunar Burst
offensiveAbilities.description: The bul-gae releases a blast of otherworldly frost that deals 6d8 Cold Damage damage to each creature in a 10ft Emanation (Basic DC 34 Reflex Saving Throw save). On a critical failure, a creature also becomes Slowed 2. After using this ability, the bul-gae's flames heat up and they can't use Lunar Burst again until after they have used Solar Flare.

offensiveAbilities.name: Thermal Mastery
offensiveAbilities.description: The bul-gae has total control over the powers of cold and fire. Each time it attacks with its jaws, it can choose to have the additional damage be either cold damage or fire damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Knockdown
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Knockdown in its damage entry

Effect The monster attempts to Trip the creature. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the monster's multiple attack penalty.
